scientific_integrity: The polynomial identities and six exact parameter samples were checked in a standalone symbolic script; infinite-dimensional Fredholm arguments require the cited primary mathematical theorem. No independent scientific audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete spectrum is classified only for odd cubic analytic symbols on the standard complex harmonic Bergman space. The 2021 predecessor was not available in full text; publication priority cannot be independently established. Only geometric simplicity is proved; algebraic multiplicity of the isolated eigenvalues is not determined.
title: A sharp two-outlier window for odd cubic harmonic-Bergman Toeplitz operators
